task.spec: Add effort estimates to the tasklab project. Tasks gain an integer field estimateMinutes (minutes, >= 0, default 0). Thread it through validation and creation so create({ title, estimateMinutes }) and update(id, { estimateMinutes }) accept it and reject a non-integer or negative value with a ValidationError. On TaskService add setEstimate(id, minutes) (validate the value, throw NotFoundError for an unknown id, return the updated task) and getEstimate(id) (return the estimateMinutes, default 0). In src/query.js add totalEstimate(tasks) (sum of estimateMinutes), remainingEffort(tasks) (sum over tasks whose status is not "done"), and estimateByAssignee(tasks) (an object mapping each assignee to summed estimateMinutes over NOT-done tasks, keyed "unassigned" for a null assignee). A failing spec is at test/effort.test.js — read it and the relevant src modules first, then make the full suite pass with node --test without weakening tests.
